featured_reviews.name: Divyang Oza
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a true story.

I had been meaning to write this Google review for a while - better late than never.

About a month ago, I visited ZEISS because my mother was not satisfied with her old glasses. We met Vrushali there, and she guided us extremely well through the different frame options and ZEISS lenses, explaining everything clearly and patiently.

After selecting a suitable option, my mother went for an eye check-up. Vrushali checked her eyes multiple times but had difficulty determining the correct power for her left eye. Instead of simply proceeding, she honestly advised us to consult a doctor, as she felt there might be some vision loss. Hearing that made both of us quite worried.

We visited a doctor the very next day, and he confirmed that my mother had developed a cataract in her left eye. It was in the early stage, which explained the blurriness. She underwent surgery last week and now has excellent vision after the procedure.

I would sincerely like to thank Vrushali Madam for being so thorough, patient, and genuinely caring. She could have simply sold us new glasses, but instead she prioritized my mother’s eye health and guided us to the right medical help.

We truly appreciate her honesty and professionalism. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to raise a complaint regarding my recent experience at the Zeiss Vision Centre in Thane.

I visited the Thane Zeiss store on 12th November to order my spectacles and paid the full amount. During the purchase, I clearly informed the store representative that I require a proper original bill as I need to submit it to my company for reimbursement.

However, today when I received a call that my specs were ready and sent my office colleague to collect them, the store provided only a hand-written bill, which is highly unprofessional and unacceptable.

Additionally, I was not provided with my vision card or any details related to the lens specifications used to make my spectacles.

Furthermore, after wearing the specs, I have started experiencing headaches, which raises concerns about the quality and correctness of the lenses provided.

I am extremely disappointed with the service and request you to please look into this matter urgently.
I need:
1.	A proper original printed bill as required for reimbursement.
2.	My vision/lens specification card.

Please resolve this at the earliest.

featured_reviews.name: Amod Mangudkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Friends,

I had distance power and was recently facing the issue to read anything. I used to take off my glasses and then use to read it comfortably, but with glasses it was difficult. This was because I now had the near power as well. I was horribly frustrated to wear the distance power glasses to see/read the distance items and remove the glasses to read the near items.

To correct this issue I decided to go with the progressive lens, so I had been to the Zeiss store (Hiranandani Meadows, Thane W). The costs of progressive lenses are way much higher but one of my office colleague suggested buying progressive glasses from Zeiss although they are costly as they are the best in technology (german tech) and also have clear vision. So, to cut on the cost i decided to use my existing frame and just buy the progressive glasses.

They have Visufit technology through which they precisely recorded digital 3D measurement of my vision using numerous cameras at 180 degree. I chose Smartlife 2.0 wider corridor lenses.

When I wore progressive lens, my eyes found it difficult to adjust for couple of days. But later my eyes got acquainted with progressive lens and now  I am able to clearly read without any strain on my eyes and also able to see/read the distance items in different light conditions. No more stress and strain to my eyes! But while climbing down the stairs one has to bend down his head a little extra. This is the only thing I noticed.

Undoubtedly, the Zeiss Smartlife 2.0 progressive wide corridor lenses are one of the best. I highly recommend to go for it if you have both distance and near power.

Things to keep in mind before buying progressive lenses:-
1) Brand matters
2) Wider corridor
3) Do not think much about high cost --- Think for the eye comfort that you will be experiencing day and night.

Thank you Zeiss for giving my eyes the best comfort!!!

Also special thanks to the entire unit of Zeiss Hiranandani Meadows store in Thane West.
Hope to continue our healthy bonding for ages to come.

I am updating my review as I felt cheated. On the owners recommendations I made the purchase which was on a expensive side (around ₹10K plus). The lens used for my specs were from Essilor or Carl Zeis don’t remember exactly. When the specs arrived I was not happy with the result of my distance and reading vision, the images used to get kind of distorted especially when I used to move my head side ways while reading. The owner was kind enough to redo my lens and it was redone twice with no change in the results. When I queried the owner that she had used branded lens how can it give such bad results ??? She did not give me convincing answer. She didn’t even have proof proof of authenticity that branded lens were used. Since the specs were not meeting my requirements I politely asked for a refund to which she politely refused. Well that was the end of it, decided not to visit the shop again.
I feel I have been taken on a ride. The workmanship was poor and the quality of lens used was poor - I could figure out that only these two reasons I could think of.
I got my specs made in my hometown with less than half the money she charged me and they are really good and I am very happy.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Gharat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got prescription lenses fitted for my Meta glasses at Tashi Vision Care, and I had a really great experience.

Hardik and Ruchi Bhatt took the time to understand my prescription, walk me through the different lens options, and help me choose what would work best for everyday use with my Meta smart glasses.

They are very knowledgeable about prescription lenses, progressive lenses, blue light filters, transition lenses, and the latest eyewear technology, we talked a lot about transitions and drive safe lenses. It was clear they have a lot of experience and genuinely care about helping customers get the right lenses in their budget instead of just making a sale.

It can be tough to find an optical store that understands Meta glasses and prescription lens customization, but Tashi Vision Care made everything easy and stress free. The lens fitting was spot on, the clarity is excellent.

If you are looking for prescription lenses, and reliable optical advice in Vasai West, I’d definitely recommend Tashi Vision Care. Hardik and Ruchi Bhatt are friendly, professional, and pay close attention to every detail.

Definitely one of the best “vision care” stores in Vasai.
